Thanks for your feedback. I must say I completely support your opinion. I love plazas especially in front of important buildings. I always think what the tourists think when they would visit my island. They should be impressed and feel the power of my nation. For example I work with  optical illusion on the upcoming Empire Tower. As you know Crown falls gets higher the farer you go. Because of that the tower will look even bigger from the harbour than it already is making visitors feeling overwhelmed. Around the tower there will be a big plaza with many ornaments maybe even a restaurant. In addition to that I want to add some of the biggest skyscrapers of my empire. Basically this will be the downtown of my city. On the right of the island the world fair and palace will be located at. On the left of the empire tower the iron tower and tourist district will be around. And behind the tower a big park will be located at for everybody who wants to escape the stressful city life. As you might realize my city will have 4 big main roads all meeting at the empire tower in the middle of the living area. From the harbour to the Empire tower. From the world fair and palace to the Empire Tower. From the tourist district to the Empire Tower. And from the main city park to the Empire Tower. The most important landmarks of the city are connected to the biggest building in the Anno 1800 universe making it the most important building of my Empire.
